snippet_primary: "I am a seller on Gumroad and my account reflects $3,816 in total sales. However, I have only received two small payments ($279.90 and $106.90) and a partial direct payout of $357 after I warned them I would report the issue to federal agencies. I am still owed $1,097.56 and Gumroad continues to delay payments with no clear explanation."
subject_exact: seller-reported delayed/partial Gumroad payout ($1,097.56 still owed of $3,816 in total sales) despite prior partial payments
local_qualifiers: partial direct payout of $357 issued after threatening to report to federal agencies
